Product Features

  • Refined table top: The top is made of MDF wood with a walnut wood grain finish that is smooth, fine, water-repellent and pressure-resistant. The round, wide top has enough space for green plants, magazines, laptops, etc., and embodies a light, luxurious and minimalist style. Tea sets or fragrance accessories can be placed on the plate to create a multifunctional social center.
  • Combinability: The product can be combined with coffee tables of the same type in the same/different colour or size to create a harmonious ensemble that matches your furnishing style. DIY combinations according to your personal preferences enrich your living ambience.
  • Perfect dimensions for the living area: With a diameter of 30 cm and a height of 55 cm, it is ideal as a focal point in the living room, apartment or sitting area and offers plenty of space for drinks, decorations or books. Ergonomically designed so you can reach items from the sofa without having to bend over.
  • Sturdy Material: This round coffee table is made of durable MDF wood, supports up to 90kg, thus meeting the needs of daily use, society or work. The bottom is equipped with non-slip pads, which ensures excellent stability – it does not wobble or tilt easily, ensuring the safety of your items.
  • Round edges for safety: The table features carefully rounded edges that not only increase visual appeal, but also provide extra safety and reduce the risk of accidental bumps and injuries.
  • Simple and elegant design: The cylindrical side table impresses with its clear shape, a classic colour scheme and a subtle, fine wood grain that shows off its elegant and understated appearance. It is suitable for a wide variety of environments such as home, office or hotel. The minimalist aesthetic blends seamlessly into almost any interior style, adding a touch of sophistication to the space.
  • No assembly required: Ready to use out of the box – no tools or complicated setup required, saving time and effort. A blessing for tenants/minimalists. If there are any quality problems or damage during transport, please contact me immediately.
  • Color variations are normal: Due to different screens and lighting, as well as the specifics of all the materials in the product, the actual color and texture may differ slightly from the illustrations – this is normal. In addition, hand-measured measurements may have slight deviations. The actual dimensions correspond to the product delivered. Thank you for your understanding.
